rules.description: cmd+tab for AeroSpace workspace navigation (skip empty workspaces)

to.shell_command: current=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/aerospace list-workspaces --focused); non_empty=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/aerospace list-workspaces --monitor focused --empty no); next=$(echo "$non_empty" | grep -A999 "$current" | tail -n +2 | head -n 1); if [ -z "$next" ]; then next=$(echo "$non_empty" | head -n 1); fi; /opt/homebrew/bin/aerospace workspace "$next"

current=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/aerospace list-workspaces --focused); non_empty=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/aerospace list-workspaces --monitor focused --empty no); current_line=$(echo "$non_empty" | grep -n "^$current$" | cut -d: -f1); total=$(echo "$non_empty" | wc -l); if [ "$current_line" = "1" ]; then prev_line=$total; else prev_line=$((current_line - 1)); fi; prev=$(echo "$non_empty" | sed -n "${prev_line}p"); /opt/homebrew/bin/aerospace workspace "$prev"
